name: agent-workspace
description: Maintain continuity records for resumable, formally delegated, or explicitly tracked work. Reuse existing task directories; short self-contained tasks need no new records.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent task status and handoff records.
interface.longDescription: Keep worklog, status, and handoff records current so another session or agent can resume multi-step work without reconstructing history.
defaultPrompt: Start or resume the task workspace for this work.
Update the task status and handoff.
